literal: Even in greatness, greatness-not-things they will not do indeed, with greatness great-manliness those who desire.
translation: Those who desire great honor along with lasting glory will not do inglorious deeds, even if it brings them greatness.
modern: புகழோடு கூடிய சிறந்த மானத்தை விரும்புபவர்கள், தமக்கு பெரும் புகழ் கிடைப்பதாக இருந்தாலும், புகழுக்கு ஒவ்வாத இழிவான செயல்களைச் செய்ய மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes that true honor cannot be compromised for the sake of temporary success or glory. The word பேராண்மை (great manliness) here refers to the supreme strength of character that upholds dignity. Those who seek such noble character along with true greatness will never commit degrading acts, even if those acts promise to elevate their status.
